messages:
Alex: hey team — trying to get Acme POC running, hitting 401 "invalid_api_key" when calling /v1/generate. Headers look normal.
Maria: can you paste the exact Authorization header and the org/project ids you're sending?
Alex: Authorization: Bearer sk-test-abc123xyz
Alex: X-Org: org_98765, X-Project: proj-acme (we set those in the dashboard). Log snippet: {"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"key not found"}
Ben (SE): that usually means the key is either deleted or bound to a different org/project. If the key was created under a different org it will reject requests that claim a different org.
Ben (SE): try `rw keys inspect sk-test-abc123xyz` or check Console -> API keys -> Project bindings to confirm.
Alex: i don't have rw CLI access. in the Console I only see keys under our main account org, not the customer's Acme org.
Jamal: did Sales create the customer org for the POC, or are they using an org we created? @Maria
Maria: Acme onboarding is stalled (SSO), so we haven't created a dedicated org yet. For quick POCs we usually create a temporary project under our partner org and generate a project-scoped key.
Alex: any safe workaround we can do now? customer is blocked on auth.
Ben (SE): two options: 1) create a temp project in Acme's org and generate a key scoped to that project (preferred). 2) for very short POC, create a limited admin key under our partner org and share — risky for security team.
Ben (SE): note the API will return 403 "insufficient_scopes" for scope issues, and 401 for invalid/deleted keys. Org mismatch looks like: `ERROR auth: org mismatch: request.org=org_98765 expected=org_12345 key=sk-test-abc123xyz` in our logs.
Alex: do we have a Console link I can send the customer for creating a project key?
Maria: yes: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs -> select org -> Projects -> Keys -> Create key. I'll spin up the temp project now and create a key scoped to proj-acme.
Maria: created key sk-poc-zz9 (scopes: infer, embeddings) in Acme > dev-poc. @Jamal can you validate network/routing if they use private deployment?
Jamal: will check ingress rules. if they hit a rate limit we may need to adjust the Dedicated pool or advise batching.
Alex: re-tested with new key — success (200). thanks! :thumbsup:
Alex: quick follow-up: customer asked how to rotate keys safely during a POC without downtime.
Ben (SE): we recommend key rotation with a short overlap window: create new key, update clients, observe traffic for a few minutes, then revoke old key. Docs: https://docs.redwood.com/api/keys#rotation
Alex: great. closing this thread unless we see rate limits or SSO blocks. will reopen if anything else pops up.
DeployBot: Audit: API key sk-poc-zz9 created by Maria in org organ_98765 at 2026-03-18T14:07:02Z.
